# Vectofi — Complete Vector Icon Catalog & Directory (Icons.md)

> Official directory index of all **17,049 production-ready vector icons** in the Vectofi icon library.

- **Total Icons**: **17,049**
- **Animated Icons**: **16,906**
- **Static Icons**: **143**
- **Categories**: **20**
- **Grid Dimension**: 24 × 24 px viewBox
- **Default Stroke**: 2px (round linecap & linejoin)
- **License**: MIT & Apache 2.0 Open Source
- **Official URL**: [https://vectofi.vercel.app](https://vectofi.vercel.app)
